fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local reporting on gambling and enforcement policy in Greater Miami; coverage of a dispute involving the Miami Herald and printers’ unions and discussion of newspaper publisher John S. Knight’s labor strategy; an open letter to Gov. Warren urging action regarding Florida Power & Light and public ownership of utilities; articles on county licensing practices for contractors, public safety and emergency ambulance response, and animal-poisoning incidents and proposed legislative controls on poison sales. Also contains community columns, court reporting, agriculture/market notes, racing news, and extensive nightclub/entertainment advertising and listings.
